intro: Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.
description:
The badger Dax, who has secretly maintained and cared for Zooville by night for years, finds himself longing for recognition, prompting a young hedgehog named Nell and her companions to uncover the truth and guide him out of the shadows.

♣ Format: A visual novel for kids.
♣ Word Count: Featuring more than 10,000 words.
♣ Target Audience: Ideal for children between 5 and 10 years old.
♣ Experience: Completely free of ads and in-app purchases.
♣ Pacing: Allows you to read at your own pace without any rush.
